history.summary: Identified as the Dangaria Baba Shiv Mandir at Ranaghat on the Pasighat-Pangin main road (NH-13), Pasighat: the CSV's generic 'Shiva Mandir, Pasighat' best matches this prominent shrine. Local accounts and review summaries describe it as one of the oldest temples of Pasighat, originally a simple shrine of Shiva, Parvati and a Shiva linga under a large banyan tree, not far from the Ranaghat Bridge with a view over the Siang. A newer 'Sri Sri Siang Baba Bholenath Dham' structure associated with Dangaria Baba worship has been inaugurated at the site. A huge puja and mela is held on the last Saturday of December every year. The temple is listed in the photo gallery of the East Siang district government website (eastsiang.nic.in). Note: a separate Gorkha Shiva Mandir-cum-Community Hall was inaugurated at 2 Mile, Pasighat, in September 2026; the CSV generic row could conceivably have meant that new shrine, but Dangaria Baba is by far the more established match. No founding date is documented in any source consulted.

name: Shiva Mandir
town_description: Pasighat (approx. 28.067 N, 95.327 E) is the headquarters of East Siang district, on the west bank of the Siang river where it enters the Assam plains. It is the oldest town of Arunachal Pradesh, known for the Siang river front, Komlighat, the Pasighat Buddhist Temple, the East Siang District Museum and the Ranaghat area where this temple stands.

travel.airport: Pasighat Airport, a military airstrip upgraded for civilian use, on the edge of town.
travel.railway: Murkeong Sel railway station is cited as the nearest railhead, about 18.7 km from the temple.
travel.road: The temple stands on the Pasighat-Pangin main road (NH-13) at Ranaghat, a few kilometres from Pasighat town centre and the Ranaghat Bridge.

visitor_information.best_time: Winter (October to March) is the pleasantest season; the last Saturday of December brings the annual mela.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Daily worship, marriage ceremonies and havans are reported; exact opening hours are not published (verify locally).
